attributes.residual: SEMANTICS, the reason this record exists: retail clamps a player's post-armour damage UP to 1.0 when it falls below 1.0; our reconstruction set it to 0.0, so any player attack computing less than one point of damage was silently discarded. This is a GAMEPLAY defect, not a scoring one, and no metric in the project reported it -- real, --clean, --ops, reloc_set_delta and objdiff fuzzy all read the function identically before and after. The function's remaining real 66 is the previously-capped +0x5a4/+0x5ac branch-polarity pair (target bgt then bne+b, ours cror+bne then beq), which is untouched by this edit and stays capped under attempt.parked.damage-enemy-p6-goto-pair.20260831.v1.
